title: Deploy the Windows jobserver helper with the queue
body: The queue already selects a named semaphore for Windows-native payloads, but the deployed source had no build/install route for box-jobserver.exe; the native-growth witness required publishing managed/BoxQueue.JobServerWin manually and passing UT_QUEUE_JOBSERVER_WIN_EXE. Keep helper publication in the queue deployment contract so native Ninja can follow live grant top-ups without lane-specific provisioning.
